Prosecutions report 2024

1. Boat owner fined after maritime incident

1.1 Defendant

Intrada Ships Management Ltd, London

1.2 Date of hearing

14 February 2024

1.3 Details

The company appeared at Southampton Crown Court on 14 February 2024. The company was convicted of failing to operate a ship safely contrary to Section 100 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995. The company was fined £180,000 and ordered to pay £500,000 in prosecution costs. A victim surcharge of £190 was also imposed.

2. Fishing vessel master sentenced

2.1 Defendant

Sam Farrow, age 33, Tower Hamlets, London

2.2 Date of hearing

28 March 2024

2.3 Details

The defendant appeared at Plymouth Magistrates Court on 28 March 2024. He was convicted of breaching Regulation 7 of the Merchant Shipping (ISM Code) Regulations 2014. The defendant was fined £2,500 and ordered to pay £1,500 in costs. He must also complete 150 hours of unpaid work as part of a community order.

3. Ferry company prosecuted for safety failures

3.1 Defendant

Oceanic Ferries PLC

3.2 Date of hearing

15 June 2024

3.3 Details

The company appeared at Cardiff Crown Court on 15 June 2024. The company pleaded guilty to multiple breaches of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995, including Section 85 relating to passenger safety. The company was fined £350,000 and ordered to pay £125,000 in costs.
